tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Mogean's catalog of US point-of-interest datasets: brands, categories, states, government sources and flagship datasets. Returns matching products with an id, title, URL and short text; pass an id to fetch for the full product card.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one catalog product by the id that search returned: what it contains, coverage, fill rates, freshness, provenance and published prices per licence tier.

tools.name: mogean_count
tools.description: Count sellable US locations, exactly, from the current data release. Use fact for one brand, category, leaf category or government source, optionally in a state; for a brand in a state, a city works when it is one of the top cities listed on that brand's page for that state. Use cut for any combinat

tools.name: mogean_preview
tools.description: Show up to 10 sample rows from one brand's dataset, with the sources and licences they come from. The timezone column is withheld.

tools.name: mogean_catalog_info
tools.description: Describe the catalog: the current data release and how fresh it is, sellable totals, the provenance tiers, what each kind of product contains, and the limits and tools that apply to this connection.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
